mechanism: Zoledronic acid causes renal impairment and electrolyte disturbances; meprobamate is renally cleared and CNS-active, increasing toxicity risk in compromised renal function.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, eGFR) regularly; assess for meprobamate accumulation symptoms (dizziness, ataxia, confusion); consider alternative anxiolytic with less renal dependence.
